# pineconebyoc_dns_delegation (Resource)

The `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation` resource has Pinecone delegate the environment's subdomain of pinecone.io to the environment's DNS zone. Use it only for environments on Pinecone's domain.

Create it right after the environment's DNS zone, so a refused delegation fails the apply early.

**Behavior:**

- Create returns once Pinecone accepts the delegation, before `byoc.pinecone.io` serves it. Request certificates for names under the subdomain through a `pineconebyoc_dns_delegation_validation`, which waits until it does.
- Changing `name_servers` updates the delegation in place.
- Pinecone holds one delegation per subdomain. When a `create_before_destroy` resource such as an ACM certificate depends on this one, Terraform replaces it by posting first and deleting after, which removes the delegation. Don't replace it with `-replace`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aws_route53_zone" "environment" {
  name = pineconebyoc_environment.this.environment_fqdn
}

resource "pineconebyoc_dns_delegation" "this" {
  cpgw_api_key = pineconebyoc_environment.this.cpgw_api_key
  subdomain    = pineconebyoc_environment.this.subdomain
  name_servers = aws_route53_zone.environment.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpgw_api_key` (String, Sensitive) The environment's `cpgw_api_key`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `name_servers` (List of String) Name servers of the environment's DNS zone. Updates in place.
- `subdomain` (String) The environment's `subdomain`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `change_id` (String) Change ID Pinecone returned for the last delegation.
- `fqdn` (String) The delegated name, `<subdomain>.byoc.pinecone.io`, without a trailing dot.
- `id` (String) The delegated name.
